name: celestial-weather-additions-updated
title: Celestial Weather Next
author: Varaxia, TheN8mare, shibadisaster, Alex Green
description:
Static weather and visual effects for vanilla and modded planets: storms, rain, snow, dust, fog and sparks. Everything is toggleable in the settings.
Celestial Weather by Varaxia and Celestial Weather Additions by shibadisaster in one mod, for Factorio 2.1. Replaces Celestial Weather (2.1 Fork): remove it. Setting names are unchanged.
